newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close sharply down on panic selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close sharply down on panic selling.

text.p: Dhaka shares lost 6.25 percent at close on panic selling as some fresh market regulations to check wild price fluctuations made retail investors jittery, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 6.25 percent or 121 points at 1,813.44 on a poor turnover of 95.2 million taka. Of 72 issues traded 70 fell and two gained.

"There was panic selling throughout the session. Prices dropped sharply. Retail investors were in a mood to get rid of the market for the moment. Only a couple of stocks could survive the pressure," said one broker.
BD Lams lost 354.92 taka to 6,695, Apex Foods shed 700 to 9,200 and Bangladesh Tobacco fell 30.55 to 279.15.
